options.name: --copy-paste
options.description:
(Default: false) Set copy-paste mode to make
copy-paste+replace operations.
-Q, --quick scan mode           (Default: false) Set to quick scan.

options.name: --case
options.description:
(Default: false) Set case sensitive search,
default case insensitive

options.name: --depth
options.description:
(Default: 3) Set depth to search in
subdirectories, default is 3

options.name: --exclude
options.description:
(Default:
.git;.vs;bin;obj;node_modules;*.exe;*.pdb;*.dl
l;*.md) Set exclude to skip files &
directories, default
`.git;.vs;bin;obj;*.exe;*.pdb;*.dll`.

options.name: --file
options.description:
(Default: *.*) Set file types pattern to
search, default is `*.*`.

options.name: --interactive
options.description:
(Default: false) Set interactive(dialogue)
mode to confirm each replacement.

options.name: --verbose
options.description:
(Default: false) Set to process in
verbose/interactive mode.

options.name: --silent
options.description:
(Default: false) Set to process in silent
mode.

options.name: --regexp
options.description:
(Default: false) Set to treat search text as
regexp.
-m, --media and images files    (Default: false) Set to search among media and
image files.

options.name: --max
options.description:
(Default: 102400) Set file size limit, by
default files with size > 100kb are skipped
